generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The use of `.startsWith()` to check if a flag belongs to a package (when the propagation flag ends with `/...`) may lead to incorrect matches. For example, if `flagToPropagate` is `//my/pkg/...`, the substring used for the prefix check is `//my/pkg`. This will return `true` for labels like `//my/pkg_extra:target`, which are not part of the intended package. To fix this, ensure that the match is followed by a package boundary (e.g., checking if the canonical form starts with the package path followed by `:` or `/`).
